conditions.carrier_matched: observed airline codes matched to T-100 carriers (bts_carrier_crosswalk.csv)

metricDefinitions.abs_error: a - b (observed minus reported), per item
metricDefinitions.rel_error: (a - b) / b, only when b >= min_base (default 10) to avoid unstable ratios on small counts
metricDefinitions.WAPE: sum |a - b| / sum b; undefined when sum b = 0
metricDefinitions.pearson: Pearson correlation of a and b over items (needs >= 3 items and variance)
metricDefinitions.spearman: Spearman rank correlation (average ranks for ties)
metricDefinitions.jaccard: |A and B| / |A or B| for route sets
metricDefinitions.note: a = ADS-B observations (this dataset), b = official statistic. Coverage differs, so these are conditional external comparisons, not accuracy.

limitations: Official statistics and ADS-B observations do not cover the same flights; agreement is a conditional external comparison, not accuracy.
The observed month is UTC (track start); official months are usually local departure dates.
Airport codes that match several OurAirports records, or none, are excluded (counts recorded).
Tiers T1-T4 describe the evidence for the airports; no probability of correctness is attached.
T-100 covers certificated U.S. carriers (all their segments) and foreign carriers on flights touching the U.S.; business aviation, general aviation and on-demand air taxis are not reported.
Comparisons are restricted to routes with at least one U.S. airport (incl. territories).
The carrier-matched condition uses an evidence-based crosswalk (route-vector similarity); unmatched airline codes are kept apart, not classified.
2026-05 contains a 66-hour ADS-B collection gap (05-05 00:00 to 05-07 17:00 UTC); summaries are also given without May.
